rows.jyutping: pou1 zo2 baak3 jau4 ge3 N
rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a road or surface covered with asphalt or tar.

example.english: This metalled road isn't so slippery even when it rains.
example.traditional: 呢條鋪咗柏油嘅馬路落雨都唔會咁跣。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 pou1 zo2 paak3 jau4 ge3 maa5 lou6 lok6 jyu5 dou1 m4 wui5 gam3 sin2

rows.meaning: made of or fitted with metal
rows.note: Use this when the object itself is made of metal.

example.english: This metalled table is so heavy that we can't move it.
example.traditional: 呢張金屬造嘅枱好重，搬唔郁。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 gam1 suk6 zou6 ge3 ci4 hou2 cung5 bun1 m4 juk1

rows.meaning: made of or fitted with metal
rows.jyutping: jau5 gam1 suk6 pui3 gin2 ge3 N
rows.note: Use this when the object is mainly another material but has metal fittings or components.

example.english: This metalled wooden crate is quite sturdy.
example.traditional: 呢個有金屬配件嘅木箱幾實淨。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 jau5 gam1 suk6 pui3 gin2 ge3 muk6 soeng1 gei2 sat6 zeng6
